title: The Second of the Three Spirits

story.text: Again the bell strikes one. Scrooge finds his own room hung with {HOLLY} and ivy, and a mighty blaze roaring up the {CHIMNEY}. Heaped up on the floor, to form a kind of {THRONE}, are turkeys, {GEESE}, game, sausages, {PIES} and plum-puddings, and upon it sits a jolly {GIANT}: the Ghost of Christmas Present.
story.caption: The Second of the Three Spirits
